divergences.upstreamResult: React createLink composes the anchor ref through forwardRef.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane components receive and compose ref as a normal prop.
divergences.rationale: Octane has no forwardRef wrapper because refs are ordinary props.
divergences.consumerImpact: Custom link components accept a plain ref prop.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Accept and forward ref directly rather than wrapping the component in React.forwardRef.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adopts a forwardRef compatibility layer.

divergences.upstreamResult: React Link callbacks receive React synthetic mouse events.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane Link callbacks receive native MouseEvent objects.
divergences.rationale: Octane exposes native DOM event semantics.
divergences.consumerImpact: Link callback event identity and lifecycle are native DOM semantics.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Type Link callbacks as native MouseEvent handlers and do not use synthetic-event-only APIs.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds React-compatible synthetic events.

divergences.upstreamResult: React Router devtools are available through React-specific packages and integrations.
divergences.octaneResult: The router binding does not publish React devtools; Octane tooling is distributed separately.
divergences.rationale: The React devtools renderer cannot run as an Octane component.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers cannot import React Router devtools from this binding.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Install and use the separately distributed Octane-compatible tooling.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when an Octane Router devtools package is integrated.
